descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
**HYPERFLUX** is a fast, arcade anti-gravity racer built for Meta Quest.

**11 TRACKS, 11 WORLDS**

Neon megacities, volcanic rifts, rain-soaked storm peaks, asteroid belts and nebulae, each with its own scenery, weather, ambience and music.

**RACE TO WIN, FIGHT TO STAY AHEAD**

Grab bonus crates for homing missiles, EMP drones and magnetic mines. Charge your shield bubble in hyper zones and fire it up when rivals attack. Damage slows you down, so hit the repair pads.

**YOUR SHIP, YOUR PILOT**

Create up to 4 pilots with futuristic helmets. Choose between 4 ships and 10 colours, earn credits, buy weapons and upgrade engine, turbo, handling, armour and shield.

**LEARN, THEN RACE**

A guided training course teaches every control. In VR, your real controllers appear in your hands with each button explained.

**COMFORTABLE VR**

Seated play, horizon-stable chase camera, optional comfort view and full 3D sound.

**FEATURES**

- 11 tracks, 3 difficulty levels
- 3 weapons, shield, damage and repairs
- 4 ships, 10 colours, 5 upgrades
- Training mode and controller tutorial
- Highlights replay at the finish
- English, French, German, Spanish, Polish

Music by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
